ns2:section.sectionText: Traceability, transparency, and fidelity are essential to sustainable agri-food supply chains. This course integrates blockchain into the study of agri-food supply chain management through 3 study modules. Module 1: Students gain an understanding of the economic theory underlying supply chain management and governance in order to provide a foundation for future scholarly or professional work in the field. Module 2: Students use the theoretical preparation to better understand sustainable supply chain management in emerging markets. Module 3: Students apply these newfound understandings to the field of blockchain and its application to agri-food supply chains. Students must register for the Lecture (asynchronous) and a lab (synchronous). Spring 2021 registration opens to non-degree students for credit on December 14, 2020 at 8:00 am, CST.
